correctness.rationale: The reviewed checkerboard matrix P=(1/64) times rows (32,12,12,8,0,0),(12,17,17,18,0,0),(12,17,17,18,0,0),(8,18,18,20,0,0),(0,0,0,0,32,32),(0,0,0,0,32,32), equals blockdiag(A^T A,J2/2) for a product of adjacent-coordinate averaging matrices A. These and the ordered block concatenation are TP2; Cauchy–Binet maintains TP2. All row/column sums 1 and symmetry hold. Reflected contrast P23−P53−P24+P54=−1/64 gives density contrast −3/32 on I2×I3, so P fails PMI. For ε=1/100000, S=(R1…R5)^5 with R_i=I−(ε/2)(e_i−e_{i+1})(e_i−e_{i+1})^T is strictly positive, doubly stochastic and TP2, and Q=S^T P S remains so. Telescoping gives |Q_ij−P_ij|<=50ε, hence reflected contrast ≤−1/64+200ε<0. Independent SymPy exact rational computation verified every ordered TP2 minor of P and Q, positive entries, stochasticity, and Q contrast ≈−0.015601954808512043. The proof and finite 6×6 certificate establish the statement completely; no smoothness is claimed.
